responses.change: Updated verifyDb replay logic to match git.snapshot_create_failed compensating events to their corresponding git.snapshot_created attempts using commitHash as well as contextType, ID, and sequence, ensuring sequence collisions do not incorrectly invalidate active successful checkpoints.

Specified and documented that writing git.snapshot_restored on restore is best-effort and non-fatal: a DB logging failure outputs a warning to stderr but does not fail the restore. Deferred verifyDb detection of restore-without-event anomalies to Feature 010.
